BrochureContent.Content:
OMD Estate Agents are delighted to present to the market this beautifully maintained three-bedroom semi-detached home located at 94 Floraville Avenue. Built circa 1972, this spacious property extends to approximately 95.47 sq. m and offers an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, growing families, or investors alike.
The home has been well cared for and benefits from a range of upgrades including double-glazed windows, an extended kitchen, new flooring, and an upgraded shower room. The accommodation is bright and well-proportioned throughout, featuring two generous double bedrooms, both with built-in wardrobes, and a well-sized small double bedroom.
A welcoming entrance leads to a comfortable living space, complemented by a separate utility area, a ground-floor WC, a garage, and a sun-filled south-facing rear garden, ideal for outdoor living and entertaining.
Location & Amenities:
This highly convenient location is well served by excellent local amenities. Nearby schools include St Ronan’s National School, Clondalkin, St John the Evangelist National School, Clondalkin, Griffeen Valley Educate Together National School, and several secondary schools within easy reach including Deansrath Community College and Coláiste Chilliain.
Shopping and leisure facilities are abundant, with Clondalkin Village offering a wide selection of shops, cafés, restaurants, and services. Nearby amenities also include Liffey Valley Shopping Centre, one of Dublin’s premier retail destinations.
Transport links are excellent, with multiple Dublin Bus routes serving the area, providing easy access to Dublin City Centre. The M50 Motorway and N7 Naas Road are also within close proximity, ensuring convenient travel across the city and beyond.
